rules.play: Choose a bet, a risk (low, medium, high) and 8 to 16 terraces. One water drop falls over the terraces and spills over the left or right rim of each basin with equal chance. The number of right spills picks the pool; the pool's multiplier times the bet is paid.
rules.pay: Every mode has its own symmetric paytable. Exact RTP is 98.4 to 98.6 % in every mode (house edge at least 1.4 %). The largest win is the edge pool of high risk with 16 terraces: ×{max} the bet.
rules.fair: Each drop is one round with its own seed and nonce. The result is fixed before the drop starts to fall; the animation only shows it.

how.lead: A single water drop falls over the white travertine terraces of Pamukkale and comes to rest in a turquoise pool.
how.step1: Pick your bet with − and +, or open the bet menu.
how.step2: Pick a risk: low pays often and small, high pays rarely and big.
how.step3: Pick 8 to 16 terraces. More terraces mean a wider spread of pools.
how.step4: Press Drop. On every terrace the drop spills left or right (50 % each); the pool it reaches pays its multiplier.
how.rain: Rain releases 5 or 10 drops one after another. Each drop is a separate round with its own nonce; drops can fall at the same time and their results are added to your balance in order.
how.auto: Choose a number of drops and a loss limit (required). Under Advanced you can also stop on a single win of at least X or when the balance is up by Y. Autobet stops when the tab is hidden.
how.gold: On high risk the edge pools are the gold pools. When the drop reaches one, it overflows and every terrace flashes gold.
how.bets: Bets {min} to {max}. Maximum win ×{maxWin} the bet (high risk, 16 terraces).

pay.title: Paytable: {risk} risk, {rows} terraces
pay.lead: Payouts at your bet of {bet}. Chance is the number of paths into the pool out of all paths.
pay.note: Max in this mode ×{max}. Exact RTP {rtp}.

rtp.lead: Exact RTP is the binomial sum of every pool's chance times its multiplier. The simulated value comes from 20 million drops per mode.
rtp.note: DEMO estimates from Sollish's own evidence; not certified by a testing laboratory.

fair.p1: Before you play, the server publishes the hash of its secret seed. Each drop combines the server seed, your client seed and a nonce (one per drop) into the round seed.
fair.p2: The engine damla-terraces-1 turns the round seed into one left/right decision per terrace. The same seed, bet and mode always give the same path and pool.
fair.p3: After a seed rotation the server reveals the seed; the Verify page recomputes every drop in your browser, path and pool included.
fair.note: In local DEMO mode the seed comes from this browser's secure random generator and is not provably fair.

keys.space: <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Enter</kbd> drops one drop (can be turned off in settings).
keys.lock: After a press, Drop and Rain stay locked until all of its drops have landed; risk, terraces and bet are locked while drops fall.
keys.speed: Normal, quick and turbo speed change only the animation, never the result.
keys.motion: With reduced motion the drop still follows its exact path, with fewer effects.
keys.malfunction: A malfunction voids all pays and plays. DEMO credit has no cash value.
